note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by two dated customs/B-L records (B/L 9713546 dated 2026-02-16 and B/L 9548984 dated 2026-02-10), both to Russia (St Petersburg, Novorossiysk), both under HS 76071991 — aluminium foil, which is a subheading of declared HS 760711/760720 (aluminium foil, not backed, rolled but not further worked). Declared HS is therefore consistent in substance; the observed 8-digit code 76071991 should be recorded as the factual code.
